title: Radiators and Undertow
author: Odile Lockridge
blurb: Elodie Crane, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
